metadata.title: Prototype Pollution via JSON.parse(JSON.stringify()) on Server-Supplied Data Objects

owasp: A08:2021 - Software and Data Integrity Failures

sources: ApplinX REST API GetScreenResponse (server-supplied screenModel / field objects)
field object in splitField() at screen-processor.service.ts:133
sinks: Object.prototype pollution — affects all objects in browser context
Cloned objects used in GXGeneratedPagesUtils.mergeScreens() and field splitting

privilege_boundary.achieved_privilege: N/A — JSON.parse does NOT pollute Object.prototype in modern browsers

impact.description: FALSE POSITIVE: JSON.parse treats __proto__ as regular own property in V8/SpiderMonkey — does NOT pollute Object.prototype. Object.assign() with JSON.parse output is also safe. Replace with structuredClone() for clarity but no security urgency.

history.note: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(serverObj)) in GXGeneratedPage:42 and screen-processor:133-134 — does not protect against __proto__ injection from server-supplied objects
FALSE POSITIVE: JSON.parse does NOT pollute Object.prototype in modern browsers (V8/SpiderMonkey). This is safe. Use structuredClone() for code quality. No security vulnerability present.
